items.q: Does multiplying always make a number bigger?
items.correct: No — multiplying by a number between 0 and 1 makes it smaller.
items.misconception: Yes, multiplication always increases a number.
items.random_wrong: Multiplying two negatives gives a negative.

items.why: On the number line −2 is to the right of −5, so −2 > −5.

items.q: How do you decide the order of operations?
items.why: BIDMAS/BODMAS sets the order; e.g. 2 + 3 × 4 = 14, not 20.
